scripts.db:prepare: npm run prisma:deploy -w llantapp-backend && npm run prisma:gen -w llantapp-backend
scripts.dev: npm run db:start && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Start-Sleep -Seconds 25" && npm run db:prepare && concurrently -n FRONT,BACK,BROWSER -c auto "npm run dev:front" "npm run dev:back" "npm run open:front"
